lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like configuration posterior to the gill slits. The clusters form distinct horizontal rows with roughly equidistant spacing between centroids in the mid-lateral zone, becoming smaller and more densely packed toward the dorsal ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes that define a geometric checkerboard pattern across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear ridges are visible running horizontally across the upper flank. These features are characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with higher pixel values on the upper surface transitioning to deep shadow on the lower surface.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, with higher concentrations located along the anterior margin and the base of the fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal organisms) positioned ventrally and posterior to the pectoral fin.
